column1: Browse and Search
column28:
h3. Objective

Enable users to browse and search products in the shopping app.

h3. Context

The app is a shopping app. It needs product discovery features for users.

h3. Scope

* Browse products
* Search products
* Filter products
* Show stock status

h3. Success criteria

* Users can browse products
* Users can search for products
* Users can filter products
* Users can see stock status for products

h3. Risks and dependencies

N/A

column1: Cart and Checkout
column28:
h3. Objective

Provide cart and checkout functionality for the shopping app.

h3. Context

The app is a shopping app. It needs support for the purchase flow.

h3. Scope

Included:

* Add products to the cart
* Remove products from the cart
* Order products in quantities
* Enter and update shipping details
* Pay using different payment types

Not included:

* N/A

h3. Success criteria

* Users can add products to a cart.
* Users can remove products from a cart.
* Users can set quantities for products in the cart.
* Users can enter shipping details.
* Users can update shipping details.
* Users can pay using different payment types.

h3. Risks and dependencies

* Payment options must support different types of payment.
* Checkout depends on shipping details being available and editable.

h3. Other information

* Issue name: Cart and Checkout

column1: As a new user, I need to register in the app so I can use it.
column28:
h3. User story

As a new user, when I want to use the app, I want to register myself with my full name, email, and password so that I can access the app.

h3. Context

New users need a way to create an account in the app.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* New users can register themselves in the app.
* The registration form includes:
** Full name
** Email
** Password
* The Email should be unique.
*  The password must have at least 8 characters, with at least one number and one special character.

h3. Other information

This story comes under requirement REQ-A1.

column1: As a registered customer, I want to log in with my email and password, so that I can access my account
column28:
h3. User story

As a registered customer, when I want to access my account, I want to log in with my email and password so that I can access my account.

h3. Context

This issue describes the need for a customer login flow using email and password.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* A registered customer can log in with their email and password.
* After successful login, the customer can go to home page and access their account.
* If given wrong credentials, app should display "Invalid email or password" message.
* After 5 consecutive failed login attempts the account should be locked for 15 minutes.

h3. Other information

This story comes under requirements REQ-A2,REQ-A3.

column1: As a registered user, I can reset my password when I forgot it so that I can access my account.
column28:
h3. User story

As a registered user, when I forgot my password, I want to reset it so that I can access my account.

h3. Context

The user should receive a reset password link by email.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* The reset password link is sent to the user's email.
* The link can be used only once.
* The link is valid for 30 minutes.

h3. Other information

This story comes under requirement REQ-A4.

column1: As a user, when I view each product card, I want to see the image, name, and price so that I can identify the product details quickly.
column28:
h3. User story

As a user, when I view each product card, I want to see the image, name, price, description, and stock status so that I can identify the product details quickly.

h3. Context

This issue is about product cards. The user wants key product details to be visible at a glance.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* Each product card shows the image.
* Each product card shows the name.
* Each product card shows the price.
* Each product card shows the description.
* Each product card shows the stock status as In Stock or Out of Stock.

h3. Other information

* This story comes under requirement REQ-B1.

column1: As a user, when a product is out of stock, I want the Add to Cart button to be disabled so that I cannot add unavailable products.
column28:
h3. User story

As a user, when a product is out of stock, I want the Add to Cart button to be disabled so that I cannot add unavailable products.

h3. Context

Users should not be able to add out-of-stock products to the cart.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* The users should know the stock status always.
* The Add to Cart button is disabled when a product is out of stock.
* Users cannot add unavailable products to the cart.

h3. Other information

This story comes under requirement REQ-B5.

column1: As a logged in user, I can log out of my account so that I can end my session.
column28:
h3. User story

As a logged in user, when I want to end my session, I want to log out of my account so that I can finish using the app securely.

h3. Context

Logged in users need a way to log out of their account.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* The user can log out of their account.
* Pressing the browser Back button must not show account pages.

h3. Other information

This story comes under requirement REQ-A5.

column1: As a logged-in user, when I am ready to buy, I want to enter all shipping details and then place an order so that I can complete my purchase.
column28:
h3. User story

As a customer, when I use checkout, I want to log in before continuing so that I can place an order without guest checkout.

As a customer, when I enter shipping details, I want all required fields to be validated so that I can complete checkout correctly.

h3. Context

Checkout requires login. Guest checkout is not allowed.

Shipping details are mandatory.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* Login is required for checkout.
* Guest checkout is not available.
* Shipping details must be mandatory.
* Name is required.
* Phone number is required and must be 10 digits.
* Address is required.
* City is required.
* Pin code is required and must be 6 digits.

h3. Other information

This story comes under requirement REQ-C5.

column1: As a logged in customer, when I place an order, I want a confirmation page to show a unique Order ID and a confirmation email to be sent so that I know my order was received.
column28:
h3. User story

As a logged in customer, when I place an order, I want a confirmation page to show a unique Order ID and a confirmation email to be sent so that I know my order was received.

h3. Context

A customer places an order while logged in. The system should confirm the order on the page and by email.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* When a logged in customer places an order, a confirmation page is shown.
* The confirmation page includes a unique Order ID.
* A confirmation email is sent after the order is placed.

h3. Other information

This comes under requirement REQ-C6.

column1: As a logged in customer, when I place an order, I want to pay by Card, UPI, or Cash on Delivery so that I can complete my purchase.
column28:
h3. User story

As a logged in customer, when I place an order, I want to pay by Card, UPI, or Cash on Delivery so that I can complete my purchase.

h3. Context

A logged in customer is placing an order and needs payment options to complete the purchase.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* The customer can pay by Card.
* The customer can pay by UPI.
* The customer can pay by Cash on Delivery.
* The customer can complete the purchase after choosing one of these payment methods.

h3. Other information

This comes under requirement REQ-C6.

column1: As a user, when I browse products, I want to filter products by category and by price range and also sort them by name and price so that I can find the products I want more easily.
column28:
h3. User story

As a user, when I browse products, I want to filter products by category and by price range and also sort them by name and price a-z,low-high,high-low so that I can find the products I want more easily.

h3. Context

Users need to filter products using category and price. Both filters should work together.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* Users can filter products by category.
* Users can filter products by price range.
* The price range filter includes both minimum and maximum values.
* Category and price range filters can be used together.
* Users can sort the results of those filters.

h3. Other information

This story comes under requirements REQ-B3,ReQ-B4.

column1: As a user, I can search for products using the product name so that I can find them easily.
column28:
h3. User story

As a user, when I want to find a product, I want to search for products using the product name so that I can find them easily.

h3. Context

Users need a way to search for products by name.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* Search should work using the product name.
* Search should not be case-sensitive.
* If nothing matches, the message "No products found" is shown.

h3. Other information

This story comes under requirement REQ-B2.

column1: As a logged in shopper, I want the cart icon to show the total number of items in the cart so that I can know how many items I have in it.
column28:
h3. User story

* As a logged-in shopper, when I add and remove items from my cart, I want the cart icon to show the total number of items in the cart so that I can quickly see how many items I have.
* As a logged in shopper, when my cart is empty, I want to see a message so that I know there are no items in the cart.

h3. Context

The cart should give a clear visual indication of how many items are in it. It should also show an empty-cart message when there are no items.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* The cart icon shows the total number of items in the cart.
* The cart icon updates when items are added.
* The cart icon updates when items are removed.
* When the cart is empty, a message is shown.
* The empty-cart message indicates that there are no items in the cart.

h3. Other information

* This story comes under requirements REQ-C1,REQ-C3.

column1: As a user, when I view the product list, I want to see 12 products per page with pagination so that I can review, access, compare, and cart them.
column28:
h3. User story

As a user, when I view the product list, I want to see 12 products per page with pagination so that I can review, access, compare, and cart them.

h3. Context

The issue is about the product list view. It needs pagination and a fixed number of products per page.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* The product list shows 12 products per page.
* Pagination is available on the product list.
* Users can review products from the list.
* Users can access products from the list.
* Users can compare products from the list.
* Users can add products to cart from the list.

h3. Other information

This comes under requirement REQ-B1.

column1: As a logged-in shopper, when I have items in my cart, I want to change the quantity of each item from 1 to 10 or remove items from the cart so that the line total is updated correctly.
column28:
h3. User story

As a logged-in shopper, when I have items in my cart, I want to change the quantity of each item from 1 to 10 or remove items from the cart so that the line total is updated correctly.

h3. Context

Each item in the cart supports a quantity range from 1 to 10.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* Each item in the cart can have a quantity from 1 to 10.
* Changing the quantity updates the line total.
* Removing an item from the cart updates the line total.

h3. Other information

This story comes under requirement REQ-C2.

column1: As a logged in user, when I have a cart value of Rs. 1,000 or more, I want to apply coupon code SAVE10 so that I can get a 10% discount.
column28:
h3. User story

As a logged in user, when I have a cart value of Rs. 1,000 or more, I want to apply coupon code SAVE10 so that I can get a 10% discount.

h3. Context

Users can apply a coupon during checkout. The coupon code is SAVE10.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* The coupon code SAVE10 can be applied by a logged in user.
* The coupon gives a 10% discount.
* The discount applies only when the cart value is Rs. 1,000 or more.
* Only one coupon can be used per order.

h3. Other information

This story comes under requirement REQ-C4.

Account locks after 5 consecutive failed attempts
column28:
h3. Summary

Account locks after 5 consecutive failed login attempts.

h3. Context

* Story: REQ-A3 – Account Lock
* Precondition: PRE-02
* Priority: Highest

h3. Acceptance criteria

* Open the login page.
* Enter a registered email and an incorrect password.
* Repeat the failed login 5 consecutive times.
* The account is locked for 15 minutes.

h3. Other information

N/A

column1: Verify password reset link validity and single use
column28:
h3. Summary

Verify that password reset links are valid for 30 minutes and can only be used once.

h3. Context

* Story: REQ-A4 – Forgot Password
* Precondition: PRE-02
* Priority: High

h3. Acceptance criteria

* A password reset link can be used within 30 minutes.
* The password reset link works only once.
* After the password is changed, the same link cannot be reused.
* A password reset link expired after 45 minutes is not valid.

h3. Other information

Steps:

# Request a password reset link.
# Open the link within 30 minutes.
# Change the password.
# Attempt to reuse the same link.
# Request another reset link and attempt to open it after 45 minutes.

Expected: The first link works within 30 minutes and only once. The expired link must not be valid.
